data_description.message_spacing: For slow devices that need a quiet line around their frames.
data_description.max_gap: Nearby registers are read in one request if fewer than this many unused addresses lie between them. Use 0 for devices that refuse reads spanning unused addresses.
data_description.address_base: Choose 1 if the device manual numbers registers from 1 (address 1 = first register).
data_description.link_timeout: No successful read for this long switches the 'Connection' sensor to disconnected. Set it longer than the scan interval.
